text:
mikaela: Heads up — getting a spike of inbound leads since ~10:12am. HubSpot webhook latency up (30–90s) and our enrichment lambda returning 502 intermittently. About ~20 leads didn't land in any RR buckets. Can we do a safe failover for handoffs?

devon: Ugh. Are they hitting the enrichment timeout or failing before enqueue? Any logs?

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook error rate 12% over last 10m. Avg webhook latency 62s. Enrichment errors (502) spiked at 10:14:18.

raj: Looks like enrichment retries are capped at 2, backoff is exponential with base 2s. If HS webhook is delayed, the work-scheduler sometimes marks as unclaimed. Suggest: temporary fallback to assign to `unassigned-ops@redwood.com` and enable heartbeat to reps.

olivia: I'm on-call — can flip routing if we agree. Two questions: 1) rollback plan? 2) will this create duplicate assignments on SF?

andre: For quick mitigation: modify RR to include a default owner rule at the start of pipeline, then let the enrichment continue async. That avoids returning 422 from our intake. Small change in HubSpot workflow: set Owner = "Unowned Queue" if `enrichment_status == pending`.

mikaela: Sounds reasonable. Olivia, if we switch RR fallback to Unowned Queue, can you monitor for duplicates in SF for 20m window?

olivia: Yep. I'll watch and rollback if we see dup > 3/min.

devon: Also propose increasing enrichment lambda retries to 4 with jitter and extend request timeout from 8s -> 20s for this window. That should reduce false unclaims.

raj: Agreed. Quick curl to update the intake config (will apply to staging then prod):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"round_robin": {"fallback_owner": "Unowned Queue", "enabled": true}}'
```

mikaela: OK action list: 1) devon -> bump lambda retries & timeout (execute now). 2) raj -> patch RR fallback (staging -> smoke -> prod). 3) olivia -> monitor SF dup/assignment and heartbeat slack channel #inbound-handoff. 4) andre -> add temporary note on hubspot workflow that owner may be assigned to Unowned Queue. 5) mikaela -> open postmortem ticket and assign follow-up (enrichment robustness). :white_check_mark:

andre: I'll add the HubSpot workflow note and post the workflow id here.

devon: Patching enrichment now. ETA ~2m.

alerts-bot: Deployment event: enrichment lambda updated by devon at 10:18:34.

raj: Patching RR fallback to staging now, will run smoke tests.

mikaela: Great — once smoke passes, roll to prod and ping here. Thanks team. :rocket:
